offerings.description: A French invoicing platform researched as a possible accredited-platform candidate, not yet confirmed or connected.

sandbox.notes: Signup at app.weinvoice.fr/fr/signup (e-mail + password). REST OpenAPI 3.1 + webhooks, SFTP also supported. Free tier: 0 EUR up to 15 documents/month, no card. Docs: api.weinvoice.fr/documentation/.

provenance.resolutionNote: Researched 2026-09-23 as a free-sandbox candidate for the French accredited-platform role, but this session never independently confirmed DGFiP registration or built any code against it -- capabilities are all false because no transport exists yet. Nuance carried forward: WeInvoice's separate 'PA Connect' product (aimed at ERPs/publishers like this one) is a paid, ~200 EUR/month tier; the free WeInvoice account is the way to develop against the same API without paying that, but production use for a third-party publisher may still require it.
